title: Congressman Eric Burlison on UAP Disclosure, Government Secrecy & David Grusch
description:
Today  I’m joined by U.S. Congressman Eric Burlison, a leading voice in the fight for UAP disclosure.

We’re discussing government secrecy, political influence, David Grusch’s departure from Rep. Burlison’s team, Grusch’s UAP motivations, and why international cooperation—including Canada—could be critical to uncovering the truth.

With competing narratives shaping the disclosure debate, who controls the information, and how do we get real answers?

Join us as we get rebelliously curious.
